# Product Squad

> Agentic dev OS for one-person teams: a product/scoping cluster, a visual fidelity ladder (sketch → wireframe → mockup → prototype), 4 brand-archetype flavors, and 66 skills in Claude Code plugin format. MIT licensed.

Feed this file to an agent to let it pick skills matching the current work. Each skill is a standalone markdown file with `name:` + `description:` frontmatter — the description states when to use it.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): operator brief — the mental model for driving this bundle
- [QUICKSTART.md](QUICKSTART.md): 15–30 min guided first run
- [manifest.yaml](manifest.yaml): full catalog + roadmap
- Entry scripts: `./draw "idea"` (visual ladder), `./scope "idea"` (7-stage scoping), `./onboard` (project intake)

- [who](skills/who/SKILL.md): Force a specific user in a specific scenario, not "users" — catches generic-audience drift ("for teams", "for anyone who X"). Use when the subject of the work is a category instead of a person.
